name: elagoht/oauth
description: Package oauth signs a reader in with an OpenID Connect provider through elagoht/session, and keeps the provider's API tokens sealed and refreshed.

templateFunctions.name: oauthLogin
templateFunctions.doc: The path that signs the reader in with `provider`, sending them back to the current page, or to `next` when given: a path on this site, checked with `collage.SafeRedirect`.

config.description: Package oauth signs a reader in with an OpenID Connect provider through elagoht/session, and keeps the provider's API tokens sealed and refreshed.

afterLogin.description: AfterLogin is where a sign-in without a next ends. Default "/".

errorPath.description: ErrorPath is a page given ?error=<code> when a sign-in fails. Empty means the built-in status pages.

key.description: KeyHex is Key, hex-encoded, as configuration carries it. When both are set, KeyHex wins.

prefix.description: Prefix is where the login routes live: {prefix}/{provider}/login and {prefix}/{provider}/callback. It starts with "/". Default "/auth".

previousKeys.description: PreviousKeysHex is PreviousKeys, hex-encoded, as configuration carries it.

providers.description: Providers are the identity providers a reader may sign in with. At least one.

clientID.description: ClientID is the application's ID at the provider. Required.

clientSecretEnv.description: ClientSecretEnv names the environment variable that holds the client secret.

issuer.description: Issuer is the OpenID Connect issuer. With a Preset it replaces the preset's issuer (one Microsoft tenant) and must then be matched exactly. https, or http only to localhost or a loopback IP.

name.description: Name is the URL segment: {prefix}/{name}/login. Unique.

offline.description: Offline asks the provider for a refresh token: the preset's way, or the offline_access scope when there is no preset.

preset.description: Preset fills the issuer and the provider's own parameters: "google", "microsoft" or "gitlab".

scopes.description: Scopes are asked for besides "openid email profile".
